A two-proportion z-test (pooled) gives z ≈ 0.370 and p ≈ 0.7113. I used the file's first data row as the column names, because the CSV header was mis-parsed.

- College graduates: 154 of 438 support offshore drilling (35.2%).
- Non-college graduates: 132 of 389 support it (33.9%).

At that p-value, there is no evidence that support differs between the two groups.

ANSWER: 0.7113
